_about: Allowlist for the context-me skill. Only vendor-published MCP servers, Anthropic first-party connectors, and Anthropic-published skills. `confidence` = how sure the maintainer is that the entry, URL, and install command are current. Re-verify quarterly; entries drift.

entries.name: GitHub MCP Server
entries.what: Lets Claude read and work with your repos, pull requests, issues, and CI runs directly instead of you pasting them in.
entries.install: claude mcp add --transport http github https://api.githubcopilot.com/mcp/

entries.name: Atlassian Rovo MCP Server (Jira + Confluence)
entries.what: Lets Claude open Jira tickets and Confluence pages by id or link, so you stop pasting ticket text or screenshots.
signals: screenshot with ticket id like ABC-123
entries.install: claude mcp add --transport sse atlassian https://mcp.atlassian.com/v1/sse

entries.name: MongoDB MCP Server
entries.what: Lets Claude query collections, inspect schemas and indexes, and explain slow queries against your cluster.
entries.install: claude mcp add mongodb -- npx -y mongodb-mcp-server --connectionString "<uri>"

entries.name: Azure MCP Server
entries.what: Lets Claude inspect and manage Azure resources (App Service, Storage, Key Vault, Monitor, Service Bus…) instead of you running az commands by hand.
entries.install: claude mcp add azure -- npx -y @azure/mcp@latest server start

entries.name: Azure DevOps MCP Server
entries.what: Lets Claude read work items, pull requests, pipelines, and wikis in Azure DevOps directly.
signals: You have been assigned to a work item
entries.install: claude mcp add azure-devops -- npx -y @azure-devops/mcp <your-org-name>

entries.name: Microsoft Learn Docs MCP Server
entries.what: Gives Claude live, accurate Microsoft/Azure documentation instead of guessing from memory.
entries.install: claude mcp add --transport http microsoft-learn https://learn.microsoft.com/api/mcp

entries.name: Playwright MCP Server
entries.what: Lets Claude open a browser, click through your app, and read pages — for testing UIs without you screenshotting them.
entries.install: claude mcp add playwright -- npx @playwright/mcp@latest

entries.name: Sentry MCP Server
entries.what: Lets Claude pull error events and stack traces from Sentry instead of you pasting them.
entries.install: claude mcp add --transport http sentry https://mcp.sentry.dev/mcp

entries.name: Linear MCP Server
entries.what: Lets Claude read and update Linear issues directly.
entries.install: claude mcp add --transport sse linear https://mcp.linear.app/sse

entries.name: Notion MCP Server
entries.what: Lets Claude read and write your Notion pages and databases.
entries.install: claude mcp add --transport http notion https://mcp.notion.com/mcp

entries.name: Stripe MCP Server
entries.what: Lets Claude look up customers, payments, and subscriptions and read Stripe docs.
entries.install: claude mcp add --transport http stripe https://mcp.stripe.com

entries.name: Supabase MCP Server
entries.what: Lets Claude inspect tables, run SQL, and manage your Supabase project.
entries.install: claude mcp add supabase -- npx -y @supabase/mcp-server-supabase@latest --access-token <token>

entries.name: Cloudflare MCP Servers
entries.what: Lets Claude work with Workers, KV, R2, DNS, and Cloudflare docs.
entries.install: See vendor page — one remote server per product (docs, workers bindings, observability…)

entries.name: AWS MCP Servers
entries.what: A family of official servers for AWS docs, CDK, cost, Lambda, and more.
entries.install: See vendor page — pick the server for the AWS service you use (e.g. uvx awslabs.aws-documentation-mcp-server@latest)

entries.name: Figma Dev Mode MCP Server
entries.what: Lets Claude read your Figma designs (layout, tokens, components) instead of you screenshotting them.
entries.install: Enable in Figma desktop app (Dev Mode → MCP server), then: claude mcp add --transport sse figma http://127.0.0.1:3845/sse

entries.name: Context7 (library documentation)
entries.what: Gives Claude current, version-specific docs for the libraries you use, cutting hallucinated APIs.
signals: docs pasted from a library site
entries.install: claude mcp add --transport http context7 https://mcp.context7.com/mcp

entries.name: Gmail / Google Calendar / Google Drive connectors
entries.what: Lets Claude read your mail, calendar, and Drive files when you ask — instead of you copying emails or documents in.
entries.install: claude.ai → Settings → Connectors → enable; then usable from Claude Code sessions signed into the same account

entries.name: Anthropic document skills (docx, xlsx, pptx, pdf)
entries.what: Ready-made skills for creating and editing Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and PDF files properly — instead of Claude improvising with raw libraries.
entries.install: /plugin marketplace add anthropics/skills → install document-skills (or copy skills/ from the repo into ~/.claude/skills/)

entries.name: webapp-testing skill
entries.what: A skill that drives a local web app with Playwright to verify UI behavior and capture logs/screenshots.
entries.install: From https://github.com/anthropics/skills — copy skills/webapp-testing into ~/.claude/skills/

entries.name: mcp-builder skill
entries.what: Guides building your own MCP server correctly when no official one exists for a tool you use.
entries.install: From https://github.com/anthropics/skills — copy skills/mcp-builder into ~/.claude/skills/

entries.name: skill-creator skill
entries.what: Helps you turn a workflow you repeat in chat into a reusable skill, and test it.
signals: same instructions typed across many sessions
every time do X then Y
entries.install: From https://github.com/anthropics/skills — copy skills/skill-creator into ~/.claude/skills/
